articles.title: FDA's Vaccine Safety Algorithm Was Broken — And Regulators Knew and Said Nothing

The public deserves to know which safety signals were missed and how many adverse events went undetected as a result.

articles.title: Parasite Protein Reverses Metabolic Inflammation — Mainstream Diet Research Has Been Looking in the Wrong Direction

The research validates the metabolic-inflammation theory of obesity — that fat tissue dysfunction is driven by immune dysregulation, not simply caloric surplus — a framework long sidelined by pharmaceutical and dietary guidelines focused on drugs and low-fat dogma. Follow this thread and it leads directly to questions the seed-oil and sugar industries do not want asked.
